text:
morgan: Need SOC2 artifact: consolidated KMS access + rotation logs across AWS/GCP/Azure. Anyone already pulled exports/queries? cc: @jia

jia: I can start with CloudTrail for AWS. Which key ARNs do we need included? CMKs, grants, and aliases?

sam: For GCP we should capture both ADMIN_ACTIVITY and DATA_ACCESS for Cloud KMS. Quick filter I use: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type=\"cloud_kms_key_ring\" OR protoPayload.serviceName:\"cloudkms.googleapis.com\"' --limit 1000`

kevin: Azure keyvault -> make sure Diagnostic Settings are configured to send to Log Analytics/Storage. Example: `az monitor diagnostic-settings show --resource /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<name>`

morgan: Need last 12 months, events: Create/Disable/Delete/Rotate/KeyPolicyChange + RBAC binding changes. Also need traces of envelope encryption calls — i.e., service principals calling Encrypt/Decrypt with key ids in request.

jia: For AWS CloudTrail -> can run CLI or Athena. Example Athena snippet: ```SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.principalId, eventName, requestParameters.keyId FROM cloudtrail_logs WHERE eventName IN ('DisableKeyRotation','EnableKeyRotation','ScheduleKeyDeletion','CreateKey','DisableKey')```

sam: For GCP export I prefer exporting Logs -> BigQuery and then run: `SELECT timestamp, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.methodName, jsonPayload.resourceName FROM \\`project.dataset.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity\\` WHERE protoPayload.serviceName = 'cloudkms.googleapis.com'`

kevin: Azure Kusto sample for Log Analytics: `AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceType == \"VAULTS\" and OperationName contains \"Encrypt\" | project TimeGenerated, Caller, OperationName, ResultType`

security-bot: rotation-bot: detected scheduled rotation for key `redwood-prod-app` at 2024-08-02T04:00:00Z — ticket #INC-5421 created :gear:

morgan: Good. For RBAC evidence we need change PRs + CloudTrail/Config or IAM change events. AWS Config + CloudTrail should cover principal/policy changes. GCP: Asset Inventory snapshots + IAM policy diffs.

jia: Note: include role session info (sts:AssumeRole) and tags when possible. CloudTrail shows assume-role events with sourceIdentity/sessionContext, include that in export.

sam: One gotcha: GCP Data Access audit logs for KMS are sometimes disabled by default. If we don't have them enabled historically, call that out and provide when we enabled them and subsequent coverage.

kevin: Also confirm soft-delete + purge-protection on Key Vaults so that purge events are recorded; we'll export purge/delete events to Storage.

morgan: Can someone assemble a one-pager listing: exact queries, export locations (S3 / BigQuery dataset / Storage container), and a manifest with object checksums + signed URLs for reviewers? Deadline EOW.

jia: I'll draft CloudTrail -> Athena SQL and place results to `s3://redwood-compliance/kms/cloudtrail/` and post queries here.

sam: I'll set up BigQuery dataset `redwood_compliance.kms_exports` and share dataset link + sample query.

kevin: I'll capture diagnostic setting ids and provide az CLI snippets + storage container snapshots (will include container path and SAS token expiry info).

morgan: Also include redaction notes (strip user PII/emails if required per PD policy) and signed URL expiry window in the manifest.

security-bot: evidence-bot: uploaded archive to https://internal.redwood.com/compliance/archives/1718891111-kms.zip (signed URL expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

morgan: Perfect. @jia please paste the Athena and gcloud commands here once you run them so we can include verbatim in the artifact.

jia: Will do later today. Quick sample I will run and paste: ```aws athena start-query-execution --query-string \"SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters.keyId FROM cloudtrail_logs WHERE requestParameters.keyId IS NOT NULL\" --result-configuration OutputLocation=s3://redwood-compliance/athena-results/```

sam: GCP sink example I'll use: ```gcloud logging sinks create kms-sink bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/redwood-prod/datasets/compliance --log-filter='resource.type=\"cloud_kms_key_ring\" OR protoPayload.serviceName=\"cloudkms.googleapis.com\"'```

kevin: Azure diagnostics create example: ```az monitor diagnostic-settings create --name kv-diagnostics --resource /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<name> --logs '[{\"category\":\"AuditEvent\",\"enabled\":true}]' --storage-account /subscriptions/.../resourceGroups/.../providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/<acct>'```

morgan: :thumbsup: Keeping this thread updated — will attach the one-pager draft soon.
